t: 第五君主主义者企图夺取对英国伦敦的控制而失败. 叛乱在几天后被镇压.
te: The Fifth Monarchists unsuccessfully attempt to seize control of London, England. The revolt is suppressed after a few …
dz: 英国复兴:第五君主主义者企图夺取对英国伦敦的控制而失败. 叛乱在几天后被镇压.
de: English Restoration: The Fifth Monarchists unsuccessfully attempt to seize control of London, England. The revolt is suppressed after a few days.

t: 奥利弗·克伦威尔(Oliver Cromwell)是英国联邦的护国勋爵,在他死后两年多的时间里…
te: Oliver Cromwell, Lord Protector of the Commonwealth of England, is ritually executed more than two years after his deat…
dz: 奥利弗·克伦威尔(Oliver Cromwell)是英国联邦的护国勋爵,在他死后两年多的时间里,在他本人被废黜的君主被处死后12周年的时候被例行处决.
de: Oliver Cromwell, Lord Protector of the Commonwealth of England, is ritually executed more than two years after his death, on the 12th anniversary of the execution of the monarch he himself deposed.

t: 法国“太阳王”路易十四在其首相红衣主教马扎林去世后开始了对法国的个人统治。
te: French "Sun King" Louis XIV begins his personal rule of France after the death of his premier, the Cardinal Mazarin.
dz: 法国“太阳王”路易十四在其首相红衣主教马扎林去世后开始了对法国的个人统治。
de: French "Sun King" Louis XIV begins his personal rule of France after the death of his premier, the Cardinal Mazarin.

t: 英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰国王查理二世在威斯敏斯特修道院加冕.
te: King Charles II of England, Scotland and Ireland is crowned in Westminster Abbey.
dz: 英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰国王查理二世在威斯敏斯特修道院加冕.
de: King Charles II of England, Scotland and Ireland is crowned in Westminster Abbey.

t: 欧洲最早的纸币由瑞典银行斯德哥尔摩斯银行发行.
te: The first banknotes in Europe are issued by the Swedish bank Stockholms Banco.
dz: 欧洲最早的纸币由瑞典银行斯德哥尔摩斯银行发行.
de: The first banknotes in Europe are issued by the Swedish bank Stockholms Banco.

t: 《海牙条约》由葡萄牙和荷兰签署.
te: The Treaty of The Hague is signed by Portugal and the Dutch Republic.
dz: 《海牙条约》由葡萄牙和荷兰签署.
de: The Treaty of The Hague is signed by Portugal and the Dutch Republic.

t: 尼古拉斯·福克特(Fall of Nicolas Fouquet):路易十四的财务总监被国王穆…
te: Louis XIV's Superintendent of Finances is arrested in Nantes by D'Artagnan, captain of the king's musketeers.
dz: 尼古拉斯·福克特(Fall of Nicolas Fouquet):路易十四的财务总监被国王穆斯克特人队长达达尼昂在南特逮捕.
de: Fall of Nicolas Fouquet: Louis XIV's Superintendent of Finances is arrested in Nantes by D'Artagnan, captain of the king's musketeers.
